page.layout: One printed page, centred on the leaf. At the top, a decorative ornamental border (no text). Below it, the dedication: an italic salutation, then three dedicatee lines in capitals with their titles, a centred "Prudentissimo" line with a further dedicatee, then the closing dedication lines in smaller type and the signature of the author, followed by a small printer's mark. No running head, no page number, no catchword, no notes in the margins.
page.notes: The ornamental border at the top is a printer's ornament, not text. A small printer's mark lies below the signature and is not transcribed. Faint show-through of text from the reverse side is visible across the page and was left out, as was a handwritten annotation in the top left corner. The printed hyphens in "Profes-sori", "Græ-cæ" and "co-lendis" are kept at the line ends. Spelling follows the print, with long s written as s.
